summary: lib/queue.sh re-runs harness_config at the top of each poll and logs `MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS <old> → <new> (config reloaded)`; lowering only gates starts. A value that is no plain whole number (2x, 08) keeps the old, logged once. 3 checks (two parallel tmux-started runs in proj/proj2, held by a stub file switch), decision file, §12, README, template line. 322 → 325.
verified_how: Red first: on the old runner l5b started only after l5a ended (no reload line); the guard check failed on a reload-only copy, which started a run past a full slot. Then the L5 block 3/3 in a scratch copy of the suite (41 s), and the full suite via check.sh 325/325 in 600 s.

dead_ends.tried: an empty MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS= as the bad-value case
dead_ends.why: bash arithmetic reads empty as 0, so starts are held anyway and the check didn't show the danger; 2x and 08 (octal) make `(( a >= x ))` fail and fall through to a start

discoveries.text: tests/stub-claude.sh: with $STUB_DIR/hold-coding present, a run's coding sessions touch $STUB_DIR/held-<run> and wait (≤180 s) for $STUB_DIR/release-<run>. It is a file switch, so it reaches tmux-started runs. STUB_* flags reach those runs through `tmux set-environment -g` on the private server (unset afterwards).

The suite now has a second throwaway project, $T/proj2: a clone with its own bare origin $T/origin2.git, reached through url.insteadOf git@github.com:test/proj2.git. It is created in the L5 block at the end of tests/run.sh.
The full suite took 600 s under check.sh this session, right at a 600 s Bash foreground limit: run it in the background.

questions: MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS=0 is now accepted on reload and holds every start, a quiet way to pause the queue without stopping it. Keep that, or reject 0 like 2x? (default: kept, undocumented)
